mapper.sql: SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',a.id::text,'agent_key',a.agent_key,'purpose',a.purpose,'execution_mode',a.execution_mode,'status',a.status,'revision',a.revision,'published_version',a.published_version,'draft',a.draft,'published',v.config,'updated_at',a.updated_at)::text FROM nw_platform_system_agents a LEFT JOIN nw_platform_system_agent_versions v ON v.agent_id=a.id AND v.version=a.published_version
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_platform_system_agents(id,agent_key,purpose,execution_mode,draft) VALUES(CAST(#{id} AS bigint),#{key},#{purpose},#{mode},CAST(#{config} AS jsonb))
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_platform_system_agents SET draft=CAST(#{config} AS jsonb),revision=revision+1,updated_at=now() WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint) AND revision=#{expected} AND status!='archived'
UPDATE nw_platform_system_agents SET status=#{status},published_version=#{published},revision=revision+1,updated_at=now() WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint) AND revision=#{expected}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_platform_system_agent_versions(agent_id,version,config,actor_id) VALUES(CAST(#{id} AS bigint),#{version},CAST(#{config} AS jsonb),#{actor})
mapper.select: SELECT jsonb_build_object('version',version,'config',config,'created_at',created_at)::text FROM nw_platform_system_agent_versions WHERE agent_id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint) ORDER BY version DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM nw_platform_system_agents WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint) AND revision=#{expected} AND status='draft' AND purpose IS NULL AND published_version IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_platform_system_agent_runs WHERE agent_id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint))
mapper.select: SELECT to_jsonb(r)::text FROM nw_platform_system_agent_runs r WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND agent_id=CAST(#{agent} AS bigint) AND idempotency_key=#{key}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_platform_system_agent_runs(id,tenant_id,agent_id,idempotency_key,input_fingerprint,version,debug,config,model_revision,input,mount_snapshot) VALUES(CAST(#{id} AS bigint),CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint),CAST(#{agent} AS bigint),#{key},#{fingerprint},#{version},#{debug},CAST(#{config} AS jsonb),#{modelRevision},#{input},CAST(#{mounts} AS jsonb)) ON CONFLICT(tenant_id,agent_id,idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT to_jsonb(r)::text FROM nw_platform_system_agent_runs r WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint) AND tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint)
SELECT FROM nw_platform_system_agent_runs r WHERE r.tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND r.agent_id=CAST(#{agent} AS bigint) AND r.debug ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT FROM nw_platform_system_agent_runs r WHERE r.tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND r.agent_id=CAST(#{agent} AS bigint) AND r.idempotency_key=#{key} AND r.debug

SELECT to_jsonb(r)::text FROM nw_platform_system_agent_runs r WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND debug AND (status='READY' AND created_at < now()-interval '30 seconds' OR status='RUNNING' AND started_at < now()-interval '30 seconds') ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 20
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_platform_system_agent_runs r SET status='FAILED',error_code='system_agent_outcome_unknown',finished_at=now() FROM nw_platform_system_agents a WHERE r.id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint) AND r.tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND a.id=r.agent_id AND a.execution_mode='MODEL_TASK' AND r.status='RUNNING' AND r.started_at < now()-make_interval(secs=>(r.config->>'timeout_seconds')::integer*10+600)
UPDATE nw_platform_system_agent_runs SET status='RUNNING',started_at=now() WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint) AND tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND status='READY'

UPDATE nw_platform_system_agent_runs SET status=#{status},output=#{output},error_code=#{error},input_tokens=#{inputTokens},output_tokens=#{outputTokens},duration_ms=#{duration},finished_at=now() WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint) AND tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND status='RUNNING'
